articles.summary: As AI agents become more common in customer service, organizations face a new challenge: coaching the AI. Learn why transcription quality, automated QA, and fast feedback loops are becoming critical for improving both human and AI performance.
articles.title: Who Coaches the AI?

articles.summary: The future of customer experience isn't about supporting every channel equally. Learn why organizations are embracing "optichannel" strategies that prioritize the channels customers value most, including voice, and invest in making those experiences exceptional.
articles.title: Why "Omnichannel" Is Giving Way to "Optichannel"

articles.summary: AI is transforming customer service, but customers still expect empathy, judgment, and human support when situations become complex. Learn why the future of customer service depends on balancing AI efficiency with human trust.
articles.title: Customers Want AI. Until They Don't.

articles.summary: As AI agents take on more routine customer service tasks, human agents are becoming more valuable for complex, emotional, and high-stakes interactions. Learn how the role of customer service is evolving in the age of AI.
articles.title: AI Agents Are Getting Smarter. Human Agents Are Becoming More Important.
